Summary: 10 requirements assessed: 4 satisfied, 2 in conflict with the design, 2 partially covered, 1 not addressed, 0 with unclear design wording, 1 not assessable. Conflicts: REQ-008, REQ-009.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the customer within 60 seconds of a successful payment.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-001: Order confirmation emails will be sent within 30 seconds of a successful payment.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Maximum limit: 30 seconds < 60 seconds, so the design is stricter and compatible.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-002: The system shall apply free shipping to all orders with a subtotal of $50 or more.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-002: Orders with a subtotal of $50 or more will receive free shipping.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Minimum threshold: $50 or more = $50 or more, so the design matches the requirement exactly.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The requirement uses subjective terms 'quickly' and 'large number' with no objective criteria.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-004: Managers and finance staff who have completed security training shall be able to approve refunds.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-004: Refund approvals will require a user with the Manager role.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design requires a Manager role for refund approvals, matching the requirement's role-based approval.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-005: Payment transaction records shall be retained for audit purposes.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The requirement is about retention for audit purposes, but the design does not specify retention periods or audit mechanisms.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design does not address how payment transaction records are retained for audit purposes.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Add a design statement specifying the retention period and audit mechanisms for payment transaction records.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-006: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-006: Customers will be able to cancel an order until it is dispatched.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design states customers can cancel orders until dispatch, matching the requirement.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-007: Customers shall not be able to cancel an order once payment has been confirmed.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design does not explicitly state that orders cannot be canceled after payment confirmation.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design allows cancellation until dispatch but does not address the prohibition after payment confirmation.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Add a design statement specifying when order cancellations are permitted relative to payment confirmation.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-008: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-008: The order service will reject new orders when the load exceeds 5,000 orders per minute.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The requirement states the order service shall never reject a valid order, but the design rejects orders when load exceeds 5,000 orders per minute.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design rejects valid orders when load exceeds capacity, violating the requirement that the service shall never reject a valid order.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-008 and DESIGN-008 with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-009: The product search shall return results within 1.5 seconds for 98% of searches under 2,000 concurrent shoppers.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-009: The search service will target a response time of 2 seconds for 95% of searches under 2,000 concurrent shoppers.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: Time: 2 seconds > 1.5 seconds (less strict); 95% < 98% (less strict); concurrent shoppers: 2,000 = 2,000.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design allows slower responses for a smaller share of searches than the requirement demands.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Resolve the conflict between REQ-009 and DESIGN-009 (98%; 1.5 seconds; 2,000 concurrent shoppers vs 95%; 2 seconds; 2,000 concurrent shoppers) with the responsible stakeholders and align the requirement and design statements.

RequirementComparisons.RequirementStatement: REQ-010: Customer payment card numbers shall be stored in encrypted form.
RequirementComparisons.DesignStatement: DESIGN-010: Sensitive customer data will be protected using appropriate security measures.
RequirementComparisons.ComparisonReasoning: The design uses 'appropriate security measures' which is vague but covers encryption as required.
RequirementComparisons.Explanation: The design states 'appropriate security measures' but does not explicitly specify encryption for card numbers.
RequirementComparisons.Recommendation: Add a design statement specifying encryption for customer payment card numbers.
